summary: Initial improvement process: work on the most frequently reported failure first.
problem_finding: Group verified failure observations by failure class and count them.
hypothesis_generation: Take the first available candidate fix for the chosen failure class.
prioritization: Most frequently reported failure class first.
exploration_budget: Spend until the experiment budget cannot cover the next step.
stopping: A line of work stops only when its candidates are exhausted.
generalization_check: None before submission; the release gate decides on held-out cases.
